supported_claim: Across all 36 admitted materials and three common state anchors, the RossFast production forcing envelope predicts route admission exactly. Where the independently frozen P2E14 thresholds remain Reference-valid and a fixed-step Reference comparator is available, every tested inside or exact-boundary RossFast case is scientifically admissible under those unchanged thresholds. Just-outside RossFast requests fail closed without fallback.
